offering_description.value: Provides claims management and outsourcing services to insurance carriers and self-insured entities, including property and casualty adjusting, third-party administration, catastrophe response, and loss adjusting. Delivered through adjusters and claims professionals in many countries.

primary_services.value: property and casualty claims adjusting; third-party claims administration; catastrophe and loss adjusting; medical management and managed care; subrogation and recovery

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurance carriers, brokers, and corporations with self-insured programs; B2G: public entities and government programs using claims administration

end_markets.value: insurance; property and casualty; workers' compensation; healthcare; self-insured corporations

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees per claim handled, hourly adjusting fees, and administration fees from insurers and corporations; project or contract: catastrophe response and outsourcing contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in claims from insurers and self-insured clients and delivers adjusting and administration services

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: claims adjusting, third-party administration, managed care and loss adjusting services for insurers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams and relationships with insurers and corporate risk managers; agents / brokers: referrals via insurance brokers and risk advisors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: adjuster licensing under state insurance departments and international regulators, data privacy and workers' compensation rules
